themes.title: Mobile app crashes, freezing, and instability
themes.summary: The mobile apps frequently crash, freeze, lag, and become unusable, especially after updates and on Android.

grounding.evidence: Known issue: "Android mobile app has intermittent crashes (file attachment, notifications)." Mobile apps (iOS + Android, React Native) already shipped.

themes.rationale: Max severity, $3.3M at risk, and a known crash issue — clears the bar.

themes.title: Login, SSO, and authentication failures
themes.summary: Users are locked out or unable to log in via passwords, Google/Apple, SSO/Okta/SAML, invites, and 2FA.

grounding.evidence: "Email/password + Google OAuth login" is shipped (login failures are bugs there); note SSO/SAML/Okta portion is separately "SAML / enterprise SSO — planned next quarter."

themes.rationale: Severity-1 auth failures with $2.57M at risk block enterprise renewals.

themes.title: Unreliable integrations (Jira, Calendar, Slack)
themes.summary: Customers need reliable two-way integrations with Jira, Google Calendar, and Slack; current syncs drop updates.

grounding.evidence: "Two-way Jira sync — committed this quarter; engineering has started. Our #1 enterprise integration ask." (Calendar export and Slack integration already shipped.)

themes.rationale: Two-way Jira sync already committed this quarter with engineering started.

themes.title: Mobile/tablet lacks desktop feature parity
themes.summary: The mobile and iPad apps are missing key desktop features (views, filters, editing, docs, admin) and often force app use or OS upgrades.

grounding.evidence: "Mobile feature parity (bulk edit, reorder, offline) — planned, phased."

themes.rationale: Explicitly on the roadmap as phased mobile parity work.

themes.title: Slow performance on large boards/networks
themes.summary: Large boards and slow networks cause painfully slow loading, pushing users to abandon the mobile app.

grounding.evidence: Known issue: "Large boards (500+ tasks) render slowly, especially on mobile."

themes.rationale: Known large-board issue with $1.69M enterprise revenue at risk and high authority.

themes.title: Broken task creation and editing (buttons/save/back)
themes.summary: Users cannot reliably create or edit tasks because create/save/back buttons are frozen, broken, or missing after updates.

grounding.evidence: "Task boards, lists, and timeline views (core product) on web and mobile" — task create/edit is a bug in an already-shipped core capability.

themes.rationale: Severity-1 breakage of a core shipped capability warrants a fix despite $0 tagged revenue.

themes.title: Broken notifications and limited widgets
themes.summary: Notifications are late, broken, or non-configurable, and widgets show wrong/limited task data.

grounding.evidence: "Basic push + email notifications for assignments and due dates (delivery timing is unreliable at scale)" and known issue "Push-notification delivery timing is unreliable at peak load."

themes.rationale: Confidence 0.55 < 0.6 — flagged for review. (was: Known delivery-timing issue with moderate $622K risk; revisit after higher-value bugs.)

themes.title: Lost or spontaneously deleted data
themes.summary: Users report projects, tasks, and columns being wiped or disappearing with no recovery.

grounding.evidence: Not listed among known issues or shipped features; spontaneous data loss is an uncovered, in-scope reliability issue relevant to "shipping what blocks renewals."

themes.rationale: Confidence 0.50 < 0.6 — flagged for review. (was: Max severity but only 4 signals and $0 tagged revenue — too thin to size confidently.)

themes.title: Sync and refresh failures across devices
themes.summary: Changes, tasks, and boards fail to sync or refresh between mobile and desktop, often requiring reinstalls.

grounding.evidence: "No real-time streaming infra today (relevant to any 'live sync' ask)." Cross-device live sync conflicts with this technical constraint.

themes.rationale: Live cross-device sync conflicts with the no real-time streaming infra constraint.

themes.title: Confusing and costly pricing/billing
themes.summary: Users complain about opaque pricing, forced seat packs, automation upcharges, licensing changes, and no refunds.

grounding.evidence: "Replacing the pricing model with usage-based billing. Per-seat pricing is fixed for the year; discounting is a sales lever, not a product change."

themes.rationale: Per-seat pricing is fixed for the year; out of scope for product.

themes.title: Unresponsive or unhelpful customer support
themes.summary: Customers report support tickets going unanswered for weeks or months and issues left unresolved.

grounding.evidence: Current quarter goal: "Reduce churn among at-risk enterprise accounts by shipping what blocks renewals" — support responsiveness is an in-scope, uncovered churn driver.

themes.rationale: Confidence 0.55 < 0.6 — flagged for review. (was: Real churn driver but $0 tagged revenue, low authority, and not clearly a product change.)

themes.title: Signup, cancellation, and account deletion friction
themes.summary: Users struggle to sign up, manage subscriptions/seats, cancel, or delete accounts, often forced to a desktop.

grounding.evidence: Not covered in shipped, roadmap, or out-of-scope lists; account/subscription self-management friction is an in-scope opportunity distinct from the fixed per-seat pricing model.

themes.rationale: In-scope opportunity but low severity, low volume, and $0 at risk.

themes.title: General praise and satisfaction
themes.summary: Many users love the product for organization, collaboration, ease of use, and value of the free tier.

grounding.evidence: "Task boards, lists, and timeline views (core product) on web and mobile" plus "a free tier for small teams" — praise is for capabilities already in the product.

themes.rationale: General praise for already-shipped features; no actionable request and $0 at risk.

themes.title: Clunky, cluttered, and unintuitive UI/UX
themes.summary: Users find the interface cluttered, over-featured, hard to navigate, and lacking view/preference persistence.

grounding.evidence: Not covered in shipped/roadmap/out-of-scope; UI clutter and view/preference persistence is an uncovered, in-scope opportunity.

themes.rationale: Low severity, $0 at risk, and low authority despite decent volume.

themes.title: Weak calendar view and no time blocking
themes.summary: The calendar view is limited/unhelpful and lacks hourly scheduling and time-blocking capabilities.

grounding.evidence: Only "One-way calendar export (tasks → Google/Outlook calendar)" is shipped; an in-app calendar view with hourly time-blocking is a new, uncovered capability.

themes.rationale: New capability with thin signal, low severity, and $0 at risk.
